AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 86 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7792, #7793, #7797, #7798 and #7799. All five are merged PRs and now carry the read-back `audit:complete` label:

- #7792 → #5845: Obsidian importer design record.
- #7793 → #7791: dogfood mcpx plugin copy synchronized to its source and tests verified; the workflow trigger/enablement defect is separately tracked on #7794.
- #7797 → #5910: KDL presentation-surfaces decision record.
- #7798 → #6215: role-socket helpers and transport-preference configuration.
- #7799 → #6901: fleet-paperwork create readback now checks body, state and labels.

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7792-7799/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7792-7799.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 86 valid PRs audited from 90 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 160 identifiers remain, next #7802. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
